slashCommands.prompt: Audit the JARVIS codebase for operational gaps. Check: (1) routes without rate limiting on high-risk endpoints, (2) routes that should require JWT but don't, (3) missing indexes on frequently-queried columns, (4) N+1 query patterns, (5) unbounded SELECT without .limit(), (6) synchronous I/O in async context. slashCommands.name: brief
slashCommands.prompt: Act as JARVIS generating a morning briefing for Captain Syed Abrar. Format: (1) Pipeline summary — leads ready for proposal, active proposals, pending contracts; (2) System health — any alerts or anomalies; (3) Revenue state — current MRR, pipeline value; (4) Top 3 actions for today in priority order; (5) One strategic recommendation. Keep it under 200 words. Direct and actionable.
